turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Happy to pass this on. The artist handles tattoo bookings in person, and I can't give prices or dates in chat. To help her, please tell me your idea, the size, the placement on your body, and when you're available.

rule.ro: Lucrările la comandă și programările pentru tatuaje le discută artista personal. Prin chat nu oferim prețuri și nici date.
rule.en: The artist answers commission and tattoo booking inquiries in person. The chat gives no price and no date.

turns.text: The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I've passed your details to a colleague: a paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, with weekday evenings available. The artist will take over and talk to you about the next steps.

input.summary: Tattoo booking inquiry. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given to the customer.
